name: Remove News, Weather and Bing Search
description: Uninstalls the Bing powered news, weather and search apps for every user and for new accounts.

name: Remove Clipchamp and Microsoft 365 hub
description: Uninstalls the video editor and the Office promotion launcher that ship preinstalled.

name: Remove casual games
description: Uninstalls Solitaire Collection and the sponsored Candy Crush titles.

name: Remove Tips and Get Help
description: Uninstalls the onboarding and support apps that most people never open.

name: Remove Feedback Hub
description: Uninstalls the app used to send feedback and bug reports to Microsoft.

name: Remove Maps and People
description: Uninstalls the offline maps and contacts apps.

name: Remove Phone Link
description: Uninstalls the app that pairs Windows with a phone. Skip this if you use it.

name: Remove Copilot app
description: Uninstalls the standalone Copilot assistant app.

name: Remove Teams, To Do and Power Automate
description: Uninstalls the personal Teams client and two productivity apps that are rarely used.
